description: Suggest a missing resort for human review. This never adds it directly to the resort index.

country.description: Country the resort is in, such as 'Austria'.

lat.description: Resort latitude in decimal degrees, -90 to 90.

lon.description: Resort longitude in decimal degrees, -180 to 180.

name.description: Name of the missing resort, such as 'Hochzeiger'.

notes.description: Anything that helps a reviewer check the resort, up to 500 characters.

website.description: The resort's website, as a full URL starting https://.

name: suggest_resort
title: Suggest resort
